When tuning α, one of the most useful training metrics is the mean squared error (MSE) between the dataset actions and the policy actions. A good sanity check is to ensure that the MSE decreases as α increases (up to the point where the policy loss is dominated by the BC term). Generally, the best value of α is achieved when the MSE is only slightly above the minimum possible MSE (achieved by behavioral cloning alone).
